stem: Arrange the following compounds in increasing order of their acid strength: Propan-1-ol, 2,4,6-trinitrophenol, 3-nitrophenol, 3,5-dinitrophenol, phenol, 4-methylphenol.

Write the structures of the major products expected from the following reactions:
(a) Mononitration of 3-methylphenol
(b) Dinitration of 3-methylphenol
(c) Mononitration of phenyl methanoate.
solution:
The combined influence of \(-\text{OH}\) and \(-\text{CH}_3\) groups determine the position of the incoming group.
(a) Two products: 3-methyl-4-nitrophenol (\(-\text{OH}\) at C-1, \(-\text{CH}_3\) at C-3, \(-\text{NO}_2\) at C-4) and 5-methyl-2-nitrophenol (\(-\text{OH}\) at C-1, \(-\text{NO}_2\) at C-2, \(-\text{CH}_3\) at C-5).
(b) 5-Methyl-2,4-dinitrophenol, i.e. the ring carries \(-\text{OH}\), a \(-\text{CH}_3\) group and two \(-\text{NO}_2\) groups, one ortho and one para to the \(-\text{OH}\).
(c) The para-nitrated ester: a benzene ring bearing \(-\text{OCOCH}_3\) at C-1 and \(-\text{NO}_2\) at C-4.
_note: Book-internal inconsistency: part (c) asks for mononitration of phenyl METHANOATE (\(\text{HCOOC}_6\text{H}_5\)), but the structure drawn in the printed solution carries \(-\text{OCOCH}_3\), which is phenyl ETHANOATE (phenyl acetate). The solution is transcribed as drawn.

The following is not an appropriate reaction for the preparation of t-butyl ethyl ether:
\(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{ONa} + (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}-\text{Cl} \rightarrow (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}-\text{OC}_2\text{H}_5\)
(i) What would be the major product of this reaction?
(ii) Write a suitable reaction for the preparation of t-butylethyl ether.
solution:
(i) The major product of the given reaction is 2-methylprop-1-ene. It is because sodium ethoxide is a strong nucleophile as well as a strong base. Thus elimination reaction predominates over substitution.
(ii) \((\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}-\text{ONa} + \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{Cl} \rightarrow (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}-\text{OC}_2\text{H}_5\)
